title: "02_clean"
format: html
---

```{r}
#|
library("tidyverse")

```


```{r}
#removes duplicate row
META <- META |>
  select(-SampleID)
#adds ASV and TAX to the the META data to create one data set
long_ASV <- ASV |>
  pivot_longer(- ID,
               names_to = "Sample_ID",
               values_to = "ASV")
META_new <- long_ASV |>
  left_join(META, by = "Sample_ID")

ALL <- META_new |>
  left_join(TAX, by = "ID", relationship = "many-to-one")
```
